grades: Finished grade 11, with at least one semester of high school left
name: Virginia Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Virginia
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model state government. Girls learn how Virginia government works by doing it, with elections, bills and daily sessions.
who_can_apply: Girls who have finished their junior year and have at least one semester of high school left. Public, private and home school students can apply. Must be a U.S. citizen or legal resident of the United States (proof is needed).
pay_detail: There is a delegate fee, but the amount is not stated on the page read. Fees are paid to the district registrar (the site lists April 15, 2027 for fees to reach registrars). Ask your district registrar about the cost and who may sponsor you.
duration: One week: Sunday June 20 to Friday June 25, 2027
deadline_text: 2027 session: June 20 to 25, 2027. The site lists April 15, 2027 for fees to reach district registrars, May 15, 2027 for all delegates registered, and June 1, 2027 for online forms. A date to apply to your local unit is not posted.
how_to_apply: Delegates are selected by local American Legion Auxiliary units by interview, whenever possible. If your school has not been contacted, find your district on the map and email your district registrar for help. Online registration opens in spring 2027 for chosen delegates.
notes: The 2027 director listed is Cheryl Shine, director@vagirlsstate.org. Delegates must stay until 3:00 PM Friday to get program credit. The pages read do not say the cost, so ask your district registrar.
